description: `<render of=@phase/>` names an enum whose variants declare NO `renders` clauses. Per §19.15.3 E-RENDER-NO-CLAUSE fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §19.15.3 — `<render>` displays a value THROUGH its variants' `renders` clauses (§19.2). An enum declaring no `renders` clause supplies no markup for any variant, so the element has nothing to render — and because the failure is total rather than per-variant, it is caught at the element rather than discovered as a blank region at runtime.
